sentences.en: The hotel sent us a welcome package with some local snacks and maps.
sentences.zh: 酒店给我们寄来了一个欢迎包，里面有当地的小吃和地图。

sentences.en: Our new colleague received a welcome package from the HR department on her first day.
sentences.zh: 新同事第一天上班时收到了人力资源部门送来的欢迎包。

sentences.en: Make sure to check out what’s included in your welcome package when you start university.
sentences.zh: 当你开始上大学的时候，记得看看你的欢迎包里都包括些什么。

senses.zh: [短语]入学或旅游时收到的欢迎辞;
